scope: FP-P3: convert FSQRT/FDIV to pause/kill/reset-capable iterative state machines in the shared 64-bit lane engine, remove scalar H dual-divider parallel copy, keep raw-bit/RMode/FPSR semantics and freeze a request-to-response latency table.

iter_engine.half_lanes: FP16 H DIV/SQRT processed sequentially in one unit
iter_engine.pause: iter_pause input supported and held 0 in current wrapper
iter_engine.reset: async rst_n clears FSM, no ghost response

design.sharing: unpack_fp/div_finish/sqrt_finish_iter/round_pack/nan handling remain common within the single release scalar instantiation
design.release_hierarchy: lcvex_core -> lcvex_fp_exec -> lcvex_fp_scalar#(FP_ITER=1) -> 1 divider + 1 sqrt FSM; no 4-lane lcvex_neon_fp in release config

runs.command: verilator --binary --timing --assert --top-module lcvex_fp_exec_tb rtl/lcvex_pkg.sv rtl/lcvex_fp_scalar.sv rtl/lcvex_neon_fp.sv tb/sv/lcvex_fp_exec_tb.sv
runs.summary: extended directed: FSQRT/FSQRT.D/FSQRT.H, FDIV.S/FDIV.H, NEON FSQRT.2S, special 1/0 0/0 -1, latency checks, mid-flight kill/reset, held response

known_limits: No Quartus synthesis/fit/STA/SOF run; hierarchy and area reduction are not numerically measured.
Four-lane combinational lcvex_neon_fp remains as standalone reference only.
No L2 lockstep run in this task.
Latency table is implementation-fixed for FP-P3; FP-P4 may revisit after workload/STA data.
next: FP-P4 full-function/workload and one/two-lane PPA evidence; then FP-P5 synthesis/fit/STA.
